startup_exit_diagnosis.summary: The EA build has (at least) three independent startup gates. offline-play handles the first two; the third needs EA account sign-in which offline-play does not fake.
startup_exit_diagnosis.gate_1_javelin_launch_guard: Parent anti-cheat signature check ('Game launch error 0x%08x'). offline-play passes it via runtime CryptQueryObject redirect to the real EA-signed .bak. CONFIRMED working on EA (loader.log: 'runtime signature method active').
startup_exit_diagnosis.gate_2_activation_EADRM: Core/Activation64.dll verifier aborts with exit code 100010 (0x186aa) and shows 'EA App is not installed/required'. offline-play v0.3.6 patches Activation64.dll RVA 0xe550 0x75->0xEB (SWOFTY_OFFLINE_ACTIVATION=1 set by the stub). CONFIRMED working on EA (loader.log: 'activation verdict answered'); pattern matches this build's Activation64.dll exactly once (static).
startup_exit_diagnosis.gate_3_ea_account_signin: After gates 1-2 pass, the EA SDK (eadp) prompts for EA account sign-in and the process stalls in early init without it (observed: window 'DisplayName field missing from registry', code never executes the engine, .rdata/.xcode stay 100% encrypted). offline-play by design does NOT fake EA auth.
startup_exit_diagnosis.local_repro: With the STALE pre-v0.3.6 offline-play binaries that were in /mnt/work/f1-ea-test, gate 2 was unhandled -> exit 100010 ('EA App not installed' dialog). Re-staging to v0.3.6 passed gate 2, then stalled at gate 3.
startup_exit_diagnosis.launcher_fixable: The 100010/0x186aa verdict (gate 2, 0xe550) IS matched by offline-play's verdict pattern on the EA user's DLL, so that path is handled. Her -1 was a SEPARATE gate the hook did not cover: the entitlement exit guard at RVA 0x112d4 that calls exit(0xFFFFFFFF). Fixed in offline-play v0.3.7 (new patch_exit_guard, signature-resolved and verified against her DLL) and pinned by launcher 1.0.6.
startup_exit_diagnosis.gf_minus1_note: CORRECTED: the GF's -1 is a clean exit(0xFFFFFFFF) from Core/Activation64.dll's entitlement exit guard (RVA 0x112d4; `test al,al; jne; mov ecx,-1; call [exit]`), NOT a signal/crash and NOT the 100010 activation verdict. Confirmed by disassembling her actual DLL. v0.3.7 flips the branch so the game continues; final confirmation depends on her re-test since her live EA build cannot be run here.
startup_exit_diagnosis.dump_blocker: SETTLED on the shipping build: the loader's EA diagnostics observed bulk decryption at the window stage (8 pages, avg entropy 6.11 -> decrypted; page 0x0 at 4.63). The string-anchor resolver therefore works once the menu builds. Local snapshots stayed encrypted only because they never passed gate 3.
startup_exit_diagnosis.dump_requirements: To finish part B, capture /proc/<pid>/mem of F1_25.exe once it has REACHED THE HOME MENU (engine running): dump the .rdata VA range [0x140001000, 0x140001000+0x5486000) AND scan the whole address space for any large low-entropy (<6.5) RX/RWX region (the protector may execute decrypted code from freshly-allocated memory, not back into .rdata). The anchor functions only decrypt for code paths that have executed (menu bindings at the menu; race bindings only after a race starts).
